scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at model (1), the force-of-infection definitions, the disease-free next-generation decomposition, equations (3)-(4), the direct disease-free Jacobian, and the persistence/endemic-existence theorems. The relevant model and next-generation pages were visually inspected. The foundational next-generation paper was inspected at its definition of new infection, progression example, threshold theorem, and discussion of alternative decompositions. The bundled exact-rational checker replays the counterexample and local-stability certificate. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects the next-generation calculation and gives an exact threshold-reversal counterexample. It does not refit the Chinese HIV/AIDS data, recompute the full sensitivity study, or assert that the fitted baseline parameter set changes invasion side after correction.

title: Correcting the age-transition next-generation matrix in a three-age-class HIV model
